authority_rule: Images are subordinate to PRODUCT.md, docs/reference/design-system.md, docs/reference/motion.md, component registry, executable tokens/tests, and final surface notes.

excluded_topics.atlas: No image is included because available generated Atlas renders over-indexed on photoreal globes, fake destinations, sidebars, and palette drift. Implement D6-28 + motion doctrine + executable tokens directly.
excluded_topics.trip: No general Trip image is included because generated dashboards repeatedly introduced travel-party/readiness/progress widgets. Implement D6 lifecycle decisions directly.
excluded_topics.sos: No image is included because generated SOS boards repeatedly became proactive help-center/triage products. Implement docs/reference/sos-ui-final.md directly.

allowed_signals: one day is the dominant mobile unit
large readable timeline atoms
recognizable place imagery used as identity, not decoration
expanded stop detail and map handoff
Plan-vs-Actual remains directly reachable
forbidden_signals: top day deck/arrows as the primary switcher; final control belongs in thumb zone
generic DONE chips as design authority
any fact not present in canonical content

allowed_signals: real Google Maps dominates connected state
mobile map owns nearly the viewport with a contextual selection sheet
desktop map owns the workspace with contextual information beside it
Directions/navigation handoff is prominent
large readable selected-place atoms
forbidden_signals: fake exact route or date data
Traffic Normal or other live traffic claims unless backed by live service
map layer controls not actually implemented/approved
visual map imitation instead of the real Google Maps integration

allowed_signals: large recognizable place image
mobile and desktop are sibling compositions, not scaled copies
high-value operational facts are visible before deeper prose
deeper detail remains progressively accessible
forbidden_signals: live open-now state unless WayPoint actually has a live source
tab names or information architecture that conflicts with D6 Guide structure
small hero treatment on Guide landing; final landing hero should be larger

allowed_signals: immersive desktop outer background with distinct readable working surface
Recent Expenses is prominent
Add expense is immediately reachable
expense rows use reusable semantic icons
split method is visible at a glance
mobile remains simple and ledger-focused
forbidden_signals: settlement/balance dominating over Recent Expenses + Add Expense

allowed_signals: desktop global search field is prominent in utility chrome
mobile has expanded top search, compact scrolled access, and a focused overlay
search remains available from any surface without becoming a destination
results are grouped by real WayPoint object type and current-trip context is prioritized
forbidden_signals: Notes/Food/Transit categories unless supported by semantic index
fake result counts, dates, distance, people, ratings, or content
